Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing port districts to lease land acquired from a commercial waterway district.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to land acquired from a commercial waterwaydistrict; and adding a new section to chapter 53.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A district may manage all lands, wharves, docks, and real andpersonal property it owns and controls that have been acquired fromcommercial waterway districts, for such purposes and upon such terms asthe port commission deems proper. A district's management authorityincludes granting licenses, leases, and easements for such formercommercial waterway district property. These properties are subject toall other statutes governing port district property. (2) A port commission may, by resolution, authorize the managingofficial of a port district to sell and convey port district propertyobtained by the district from a commercial waterway district. Thedistrict shall sell and convey such property in accordance with allapplicable statutes governing the sale of port district property.
